messages:
mai: CI flagged a perf threshold on PR #18234 — microbench 'kernel_select_latency' jumped ~+14% on our A100 workers. This came up in the post-merge smoke; flagging as potential rollout blocker.

jordan: ugh, saw that in the dashboard. Which commit in the PR touched kernel selection heuristics?

mai: The PR touched batcher + kernel-autoselect logic. Diffs: changed affinity scoring from [tx, rx, kv] weights to normalized scores.

ci-bot: CI Benchmark Report: PR 18234 - microbench-suite
```
env: linux-a100-4
benchmark: kernel_select_latency
baseline: 1.8ms
current: 2.05ms (+13.9%)
p95: 4.1ms -> 4.9ms
notes: tail increased, KV cache hitrate unchanged
```

vikram: interesting that kv hitrate didn't change. Could be the affinity normalization pushed more seq_len=1 small requests to a different kernel with higher startup cost. Any flamegraphs?

mai: Attached a quick heap/profile snippet from the failing CI run:
```
# top hot paths
1  38.2%  kernel_selector::score_candidates
2  21.1%  batcher::coalesce
3  12.5%  runtime::launch_kernel_overhead
```

emily: can we reproduce locally with the same microbench harness? I can run the regtest with --seed=42 and same trace.

jordan: I started a local run; initial runs look noisy but I see the select path taking longer when candidate list > 3. Looks like an O(n^2) loop creep after the normalization change.

luis: If it's O(n^2) we need a fix fast. Two options: revert the normalization or short-circuit when candidate count > 8. Which is safer for rollout?

mai: Revert would be safest for immediate unblock. But we might be able to hotfix with a cheap guard: precompute normalized weights once and >= 8 fall back to coarse heuristic.

vikram: I can put up a PR with the guard. If tests pass, we can land and rerun CI. Otherwise revert.

mai: @vikram please go ahead. @ci-bot schedule rerun after merge. This is blocking the deploy for Dedicated pool tonight. :exclamation:

ci-bot: Rerun queued: PR-18234 microbench suite (post-hotfix). Will post results.

jordan: also adding a small unit test for candidate list scaling so this doesn't regress silently.

emily: local replay finished; guard reduces selector time back to baseline in my env. p95 tail improved too.

luis: thanks — if CI confirms, let's avoid a full revert. Also add a perf annotation to the commit to help bisects in future.

mai: Agreed. I'll hold the rollout until CI green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
